import { defineTable, col, rel } from "@rebasepro/server/schema";
import { city } from "./city";
import { customer } from "./customer";
import { staff } from "./staff";
import { store } from "./store";

export const address = defineTable("address", {
    columns: {
        addressId: col.serial().primaryKey(),
        address: col.text().notNull(),
        address2: col.text("address2"),
        district: col.text().notNull(),
        cityId: col.integer().notNull(),
        postalCode: col.text(),
        phone: col.text().notNull(),
        lastUpdate: col.timestamp({ withTimezone: true }).notNull().onCreateNow()
    },
    relations: {
        city: rel.belongsTo(() => city),
        customer: rel.hasMany(() => customer),
        staff: rel.hasMany(() => staff),
        store: rel.hasMany(() => store)
    },
    rls: "admin-only"
});
